name: Beam Cloud On-demand - A100 80GB SXM4
price_basis: per A100 80GB SXM4 machine-hour, on-demand, including 16 vCPU + 128 GB RAM + 1 TB NVMe. Fetched 2026-10-04. This is a per-machine rate for a single-GPU machine, so it is also the per-GPU rate.
notes: Beam on-demand A100 80GB SXM4 at $1.36/hr is the cheapest published A100 rate from any managed provider. It is 50% below CoreWeave on-demand A100 ($2.70), 67% below AWS p4d ($4.10), and 73% below Replicate ($5.04). The rate includes the full machine (16 vCPU, 128GB RAM, 1TB NVMe). Beam charges no egress fees. The A100 SXM4 is the SXM variant with full NVLink support.
